book.title: 近紅外光譜：最佳光徑選擇
book.language: zh (Traditional, zh-Hant page; engine audio folder zh)
book.readers: 專題研究學生；二階導數、回歸、LOD、LOOCV 需重新教

words: 使用者：利用 papermorph 製作最佳光徑選擇的教學，附 R 及 Python（Jupyter 與 Colab）程式給學生練習及驗證。
對象是專題研究的學生，但二階導數、回歸、LOD、留一交叉驗證的基礎都還要再教一次。

look.notation: numbers as in analysis/光徑選擇報告.md; d2 in per-point² (index spacing); narration says numbers in words

pacing.checks: three quick checks in the lesson, three practice items at the end

data: lib/nirdata.js from tools/nir-pathlength/make_data.py (teaching/data/spectra_long.csv); Traditional UI strings from tools/nir-pathlength/make_zh_hant.py
